items.name: Json
items.summary: Marker for [`Format`] that indicates that the newline-delimited JSON log format should be used.

methods.name: flatten_event
methods.summary: If set to `true` event metadata will be flattened into the root object.

methods.name: with_current_span
methods.summary: If set to `false`, formatted events won't contain a field for the current span.

methods.name: with_span_list
methods.summary: If set to `false`, formatted events won't contain a list of all currently entered spans. Spans are logged in a list from root to leaf.
